traceability.notes:
All requirements and acceptance criteria from docs/stories/021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX.story.md are implemented and verified:
- File-level @supports template (REQ-TEST-FIX-TEMPLATE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PLACEHOLDER) is implemented via ensureFileSupportsAnnotation, buildSupportsTemplateComment, and insertSupportsTemplate, inserting a JSDoc comment at the top of test files (after any shebang) with a generic story path, generic REQ IDs, and a clear TODO line. Tests confirm the exact before/after behavior. - Malformed [REQ-XXX] prefixes (REQ-TEST-FIX-PREFIX-FORMAT) are normalized by normalizeReqPrefixInDescription and normalizeReqId, handling spacing, underscores, lowercase, and parentheses. The rule only fixes cases where an existing REQ identifier is present at the start, and leaves already-correct prefixes unchanged, as verified by multiple test cases. - Safety and non-inference guarantees (REQ-TEST-FIX-SAFE, REQ-TEST-FIX-NO-INFERENCE, REQ-TEST-FIX-PRESERVE) are baked into the design: only strings and comments are changed; no test implementation code is touched; fixes are skipped if no recognizable REQ id exists (e.g., plain "missing prefix"), and string literal rewrites preserve quote style and escaping. The file-level template is always a neutral placeholder with TODO guidance and cannot change runtime behavior. - Integration with ESLint --fix is correct: the rule is marked fixable, uses context.report with fixer callbacks for both template insertion and prefix normalization, and is wired as traceability/require-test-traceability in src/index.ts. RuleTester tests that specify `output` confirm that eslint --fix would produce the documented changes. - User-facing documentation (API Reference) has been updated to describe these auto-fix behaviors and configuration options, satisfying the documentation acceptance criterion and the Definition of Done item about documenting auto-fix capabilities.
Given the concrete implementation, passing tests directly tied to this story’s REQ IDs, and updated docs, the story 021.0-DEV-TEST-ANNOTATION-AUTO-FIX is fully implemented and passes.
